title: PED modpack
description: Modpack for friends who all have different interests in the game but still want to play together.
body:
# About:
This modpack aims to bring friends with different intrests together. Each of you can do your things with the different groups of mods this modpack offers. You can restrict everyone to their own mod group or let everyone use whatever they need.
## Mod groups:
### Engineering
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/project/LNytGWDc)
- [Crafts & Additions](https://modrinth.com/project/kU1G12Nn)
- [Steam 'n' Rails](https://modrinth.com/project/ZzjhlDgM)
- [Copycats+](https://modrinth.com/project/UT2M39wf)
- and some of Creates other addons
### Weapon makers
- [Tinkers' Construct](https://modrinth.com/project/rxIIYO6c)
- [Tinkers Tool Leveling 2](https://modrinth.com/project/Tt9OkMjz)
- [TiCEX - Tinkers Construct EX](https://modrinth.com/project/ZDgJ7ogS)
### Mystics
- [Botania](https://modrinth.com/project/pfjLUfGv)
- [Malum](https://modrinth.com/project/jgzwYsAN)
- [Totemic](https://modrinth.com/project/GLffYJtD)
### Farmers
- [Let's Do](https://modrinth.com/project/HJetCzWo) mod family
- [Dave's Potioneering](https://modrinth.com/project/TaH1eXdZ)
- [Potion Cauldron](https://modrinth.com/project/yTSyrZpM)

Other mods are for optimization or for everyone to enjoy

For better experience use my [datapack](https://modrinth.com/project/XaAk8Zyr) and [resourcepack](https://modrinth.com/project/tKzdIhL0).

# Important!
Right now [Create: Design n' Decor](https://modrinth.com/project/x49wilh8), [Create: Interactive](https://modrinth.com/project/MyfCcqiE) and [Valkyrien Skies](https://modrinth.com/project/V5ujR2yw) NEEDS to be disabled.
